summary.text: Son of Caeneus from Magnesia, Argonaut paired with Priasus in Hyginus' catalogue — not the Aeacid Phocus.

story.text: Hyginus names Phocus and Priasus sons of Caeneus from Magnesia among the crew.

The catalogue names Magnesia as their region but no individual polis — Iolcus, Pagasae, Meliboea, and the other Magnesian towns of our map are not assigned to this pair in any ancient roll. Residence stays deferred at regional level only.
